acceptance_criteria.guardrail: medium/large pooled Recall does not regress materially; CDD/WHU not materially worse
mechanism_selfchecks: [HFAE-GRAD] step-1 hf_tap_grad_norm > 0 (edge gradient really reaches the HF branch)
acceptance_criteria.accept: at least one of E9/E10 has F1 >= CTRL on >=3/4 datasets AND SYSU F1 > CTRL, with all mechanism self-checks passing
acceptance_criteria.if_negative: record as negative result with mechanism attribution (same as Run6 practice); no threshold retuning

risks.R1_info_already_in_head: Run6 showed the FP-discrimination info is in head (AUC 0.9565); HFAE targets the RECALL/localization side (F04: SYSU small pooled recall 0.1974) and reshapes representations rather than re-reading features — verified by T5
risks.R2_novelty_occupied: R8 EdgeRefNet (TGRS 2026) occupies edge-guided refinement + edge supervision; must be positioned as an internal STR ablation, not a third contribution; re-verify R8 details before writing
risks.R3_lambda_is_new_hparam: lambda=0.2 pre-registered and fixed; no search
risks.R6_cross_dataset_transfer: report per-dataset, do not average away negatives
